statements.text: We need to block China from stealing or using our IP to develop and weaponize artificial intelligence.
statements.context: Senate hearing on national security challenges and outpacing China in emerging technology, where Senator Fetterman questions expert panelists.

statements.text: committed to making sure there are clear and enforceable protections around AI, and I oppose any provision that would ban states from trying sensible regulation.
statements.venue: Statement on the proposed federal moratorium on state AI regulation (via LNP)

statements.text: we must win the war for AI over China, and that's why I'm still very supportive of data centers and A lot of the opposition and these opinions have emerged from paid kinds of, of misinformation from the Chinese because they definitely want to win and they want to build as many data centers.
statements.venue: Podcast interview (transcript): Breaking With the Far Left on AI, Energy and Israel

statements.text: The emerging chassis of AI must be built by America. We can put appropriate guardrails in place without handing the win on AI to China. A moratorium is China First.
statements.venue: X post on Sanders/AOC data center moratorium bill (via Fox News)

statements.text: You know, people in my party are now becoming anti-AI and data centers. You know, people in my party are calling for a moratorium in our country. That’s lunacy. That’s China-first kind of a policy in our nation.
statements.venue: Fox News Channel interview (via The Hill)

statements.text: America must lead in the development of AI, otherwise we live under China's rules. That must not happen.
statements.venue: X post responding to story on Bernie Sanders's call for an AI pause (via Pennlive)

statements.text: AI supremacy and energy dominance underpins our national security. China continues to fuel and benefit from our overreaction. I reject the political pandering and hyperbole over data centers or AI doomsdaying.
We must win the war for AI supremacy over China. They foment the ‘anti’ argument through misinformation.
There’s nothing more damaging to a Democrat than agreeing with Trump AND data centers — but what’s right is right.
statements.venue: X post on Trump's data center post (via Philadelphia Inquirer)

statements.text: AI will transform not just transportation, agriculture, you know, all of it. I think it’s entirely appropriate to put that front and center and make it formal in our government now.
statements.venue: AI Horizons Pittsburgh summit remarks, calling for a Cabinet-level AI position (via Allegheny Front)

statements.text: After all, AI is the modern era’s Manhattan Project. Communist China knows that AI supremacy confers global economic, ideological, and national security dominance. If we cede AI leadership to totalitarian China, we risk surrendering our way of life.
statements.venue: The Free Press op-ed co-authored with Sen. Dave McCormick

statements.text: To win the AI race, America needs more brute computation and energy, which means more data centers. It is a national security imperative. These projects also create good-paying jobs and increased tax revenue that supports schools, policing, and infrastructure.
statements.venue: The Free Press op-ed co-authored with Sen. Dave McCormick

statements.text: If a company develops an extraordinarily powerful AI system that causes catastrophic harm, there has to be accountability. In the same way that the law imposes consequences for cyberattacks, fraud, and theft of intellectual property, Congress should clarify the responsibilities that AI developers and hosts have when a model goes rogue.
statements.venue: The Free Press op-ed co-authored with Sen. Dave McCormick

statements.text: The federal government must set national safeguards, such as age thresholds for AI usage, that prevent AI exploitation of children.
statements.venue: The Free Press op-ed co-authored with Sen. Dave McCormick

statements.text: We face a risk with AI, without a doubt, but people are calling for a moratorium. Congratulations, the Chinese would love that, you know, because then they will hit the gas, and we will live the rules of the AI that they create. We have to win. This is a Manhattan Project … I’m grateful that the frontier models are in our hands, could you imagine if they were in Iran or any other nations?
statements.venue: McCain Institute conversation with Mike Pence
